before_text: --- title: "Taylor — Poetry and Authored Images" record_id: mytheme-taylor-authored-images record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: Extracted / Argued from textual_status: developed-draft-awaiting-parent-T22 poem_units: 23 admitted_image_units: 14 --- # Taylor — Poetry and Authored Images ## #0 — A word that can return to its speaker A game reaches checkmate and asks to be played again. A definition lets air through its panes. A speaker who has understood capture discovers himself seeking its soothing once more. Taylor's poems give these returns different bodies. Their sounds, intervals, pronouns and endings let the relation be lived before an account collects it. The poems remain twenty-three individual works within this authored whole; a shared philosophical field gives them relations without making them fragments of an unwritten master poem. The [Personal Poetry Corpus](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#complete-poems) **sources** the complete texts below. It distinguishes ten undated earlier works, the six-work P0→P5 composition, and seven dated journal works from March–June 2026. The order here is that compilation's order; it does not pretend that the June sequence chronologically preceded the March poems. Bracketed first-line titles are indexes where no authorial title was found. Each quotation retains the compilation's exact wording and lineation. Subsequent authorial corrections are stated beside their own poems so that text, revision instruction and commentary remain distinguishable. This is Taylor's situated authorial world. The language is English; the dated journal encounters and June composition supply particular occasions of production. No birthplace or geographical route is inferred from a file location. [Neumann's shared archetypal ground](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round) carries the structuration of genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay. That common morphology remains distinct from the geography of particular tellings and from the order and duration of their transformations. It makes relations comparable without converting Taylor's dated works into stages of a universal cultural chronology. The psychological morphology and Taylor's native derivation also keep distinct source offices. The native field is complete before a local image receives a formal reading: `/ = −/−`, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, `1/0`. The slash and inverted parent enclose neither a miscellaneous list nor a one-way ladder. Each parent opens its full four-and-two articulation, and return permits the inverse passage. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3, and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 give the sequential harmonics; Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4, and Text/Texture at 2+3 give a different, complementary reading. The [core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** that authorial field. Its `X/x` is Taylor's notation. Neither Neumann nor a poem supplies its derivation retrospectively. The sixfold of this page follows the corpus's own changing forms; it does not distribute all twenty-three works among six prefabricated meanings. The prose immediately following a poem describes its words and complete movement. Symbolic amplification is identified separately: **human-amplified: yes** where the authored programme or a precise correction supplies the relation; additional interpretive extrapolation remains **human-amplified: no**. Reading a complete work is not permission to assign every bird, vessel or god-name a fixed cross-story identity. ## #1 — Play, knowing, and the humanity that makes its forms The earlier works move among address, recognition, institutional desire and release. Their lengths matter: the two-line fatigue of waking and the extended rain against the window of freedom do different work. Each begins again in its own voice. ### FT-P01 — Play and Play > Somehow, being right here > I am out there, everywhere, > Nowhere really, > And elsewhere completely. > Coming and Going; > Checkmate. > Another game? > I might as well stay knowing > If I set you going > You'll come again. > Let us play and play. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q001) · Extracted authorial poem. The voice moves from being here to being everywhere and nowhere, reaches checkmate, then asks for another game. Staying in knowing and setting another going belong to one invitation: the other can come again. The final repetition of play opens what the apparent ending had closed. Its address to you is part of that reopening; the poem would lose its return if reduced to an assertion that everything is one. ### FT-P02 — Mystery Is Infinitely Deeper > Mystery is infinitely deeper than the simply unknown or unknowable; > It is the relative knowability of the Unknown > And the ultimate unknowability of the Known; > The Known alone is the wrong focal point for Knowing, and it will always spit back at us the empty husk; > Knowing itself is the Mystery, > The conjugal Joy of the Known and the Knower, eternally trussed. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q002) · Extracted authorial poem. The first turn gives the Unknown a relative knowability and removes final possession from the Known. The husk is what comes back when knowing fixes exclusively on its object. The last two lines restore the act and its participants: Known and Knower are held in a conjugal relation whose joy belongs to Knowing. Mystery therefore deepens as the relation becomes articulate; accumulating an inventory of unknown things would miss the poem's change of focus. ### FT-P03 — It Takes One to Know One > It's certainly true that it takes one to know one. > Truer still that it takes the One to Know the One. > Thus True Knowing takes one and makes one no one, just so that no-one, One, knows One. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q003) · Extracted authorial poem. The familiar saying passes through three changes of case and agency. One recognises another; the One knows the One; knowing then takes the separate claimant through no-one. The final line lets the repeated word keep several offices without allowing the individual knower to retain possession of them all. Its commas and capitals perform those turns. A uniform spelling of one would remove the differences through which this recognition proceeds. ### FT-P04 — The Zero and the One > The 0 is the One, the 1 is the All! Thus the All is none, once and for all. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q004) · Extracted authorial poem. The single breath distinguishes the whole One at 0 from the enumerated All at 1, then releases the latter's claim to finality through none and once and for all. The wit depends on the Two Ones retaining different offices. This is Taylor's numerical poetic expression; its symbolic use of number travels back to the native derivation rather than supplying an independent arithmetic proof. ### FT-P05 — Every Field Is a Way > Every field is a way, > Every way a field > Born to yield > Truth unconcealed > So vistas open > In the day's veil > And paths lead on > Ever availed > > As is the seal > Wont to entail > The opening of sight > And sense's portrayal > Too the bird in flight > The wind regales > The end all and be all > From Real to re-All [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q005) · Extracted authorial poem. Field becomes way and way becomes field before either can close into an object. The first stanza makes disclosure a movement through vistas and paths. The second gives the seal an opening office, then lets sight become flight in the wind. Real returns as re-All: the poem re-enters the field of particulars from the reality they disclose. Its sound pattern carries the transition through yield, veil, entail and portrayal; none of those words alone substitutes for the passage. ### FT-P06 — Searching High and Low > Searching high and low, > near and far for a clue; > Who's to know, and > In deed, > Who ever knew? > The Truth's as much what ever was > As what's ever anew. > No secret is safe with I; > About Time the Truth flew, > For the many > As much as for the few. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q006) · Extracted authorial poem. Searching changes from a question about where the clue lies to a question about who knows. What ever was and what is ever anew meet within the same Truth. The final movement releases the secret from exclusive custody: it flies for the many as much as the few. The capital I and the play on Time belong to this turn from seeking outward to making what is known available. ### FT-P07 — I Dream Of > I dream of a truly Humanised spirituality, > And of the truly Spiritualised human — > Failing this, there will be nothing and no one to seek. > > I dream of institutions which respect their constitution, > And don't devour the humanity that made and makes them [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q007) · Extracted authorial poem. The first stanza makes humanisation and spiritualisation reciprocal tasks, with the possibility of seeking itself at stake. The second gives that reciprocity an institutional demand. Humanity both made and makes the institution; the present tense prevents an originating act from becoming an exhausted historical credit. An institution that consumes this continuing humanity devours its own constitution. The poem's dream is an expressed aspiration with a social consequence. ### FT-P08 — Waking Up > Waking up is just a matter of getting tired > Of all the bullshit. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q008) · Extracted authorial poem. The first line raises the expectation of an account of awakening and brings it down to getting tired. The second names what exhausts the speaker. The shortness matters: the poem offers no ladder of superior attainments after that exhaustion, and its final word declines the decorum through which the same evasion could continue. ### FT-P09 — Freedom > Tell me; how is freedom free > If it be > Bound by law and > Contingency? > Freedom is a rule to itself > Or better yet > The Rule of The Self. > It's no pittance felt > Of irony dealt > In a house of liberation > Admonition, pelt lifted, > Rain against the window > Of Soul; > The eye of the wind within > Shan't know the pigeonhole; > The message comes through regardless. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q009) · Extracted authorial poem. Freedom begins under examination: how could it remain free while being bound by law and contingency? Rule changes its office when the poem passes from a rule to itself to the Rule of The Self. The house of liberation then meets rain at its window. By the end, wind, eye and message pass beyond the pigeonhole that would classify their arrival. This is a movement in the experience of freedom, not a legislative claim that every particular action is exempt from consequence. ### FT-P10 — Beyond All Borders > Beyond all borders, Knowing without defense, > Beyond all realities, Being, True without pretense. > Without defense, no wars for waging, nor could there be waging against. > Without pretense, no amount of slighting can even slightly sully sense. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q010) · Extracted authorial poem. The opening pair gives Knowing and Being parallel releases from defence and pretence. The following pair pursues what each release makes possible: war loses its occasion in one, while slighting cannot soil sense in the other. The last line tests its claim in sound, letting slighting approach slightly without letting injury acquire the final authority to determine what is real. ## #2 — Two roads, six works, and the return through the loop The P0→P5 order belongs to this composition. P3 and P4 are a consequential pair: one unfolds the productive play of distinction, the other addresses its severing misuse. Their complementary lean is **human-amplified: yes** in the authored six-route programme. A return through the sequence does not create a seventh poem. ### FT-P11 — P0: The two roads of two > 2 → (−1) + 1 = 0 > 2 → 0/1 → 00, 01, 10, 11 + 0, 1 = 4 + 2 [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q011) · Extracted authorial poem. Both routes begin with two. The first resolves the poles as opposed signed ones and cancels them to zero. The second retains 0 and 1, generates their four ordered pairings, and keeps the generating two alongside the four: 4+2. The printed rows are the entire numerical poem. Their difference is the fate of relation under the two operations, not a preference for one decorative numeral over another. ### FT-P12 — P1: What binary cannot compute > What binary cannot compute, > What thinking cannot know, > Where two see the common root, > There our powers grow. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q012) · Extracted authorial poem. The shared root enters where binary computation and thinking meet their stated limits. Two recognise it, and our powers grow: the ending moves into the first-person plural. Following the numerical fork, this small poem makes the increase of power dependent on a relation that the isolated poles could not supply. Its claim remains in the native and poetic register; it reports no benchmark about computing machines. ### FT-P13 — P2: Where life leads > Where life leads, > There words transfix. > Where life flows, > There words shall slip. > Where language stays, > Understanding frays, > Let language cave, > And lay bare the way, > Over the edge, under the lips. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q013) · Extracted authorial poem. Life leads and flows while words alternately transfix and slip. When language stays, understanding frays; language must then cave to lay the way bare. Cave changes from a possible enclosure into an enacted yielding. The last line crosses the edge beneath the lips, bringing the physical place of speech into the release of speech. Its own words accomplish the approach to their limit. ### FT-P14 — P3: 2 to two ones > 2 to two ones, one or the other one, summed to none, already a one and done-er. > > 2 through the two ones, the whole and natural number, where one as first is both rooted in none and number, the 0 and 1, One and All, never rent asunder. Never falling into enmity, two plays itself apart and becomes again projected by it's chiaroscuric/contrastive arts, two upon itself, plus itself, 4+2. Looking back with love it wraps itself up, 6 perfection seeking recollection of the one that is it's two, ring around the Rosie until you fall down through the loop. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q014) · Extracted authorial poem. The prepositions carry the fork: two goes to two opposed ones in the opening stanza, and through the Two Ones in the second. Differentiation is playful and productive here. Contrast projects two upon itself while retaining its generating pair, then love turns the six toward recollection. The children's ring ends by falling through the loop. The ending changes the meaning of perfection: completing the figure makes return possible rather than enthroning a finished enclosure. ### FT-P15 — P4: There’s one underlying issue in our age > There’s one underlying issue in our age. One could say, One is the underlying issue of our age… Let me rephrase, how the One is to one, this underscores and is setting our stage. Collectively we haven’t a frame open enough to let the evening wane or the one air in through released panes, to be breathed all the same. Are you one? Are we one whole together? Galaxies, planets, seasons, angels, demons, bodies, bots, the weather? Where between each one is One’s tether? Two is the first sign that one must endeavour, married to the bond by a lifetime of together, time dividing not for war but for dreaming towards forever. The one issue; we forgot that one really is two. We almost always see to two as two, because mind must split, divide and polarise, to know is to sever. What amounts, by all accounts, isn’t very clever. Firstly, it is completely derived. So late on the scene did this thinking arise, yet its high water mark is hubris despite; each apotheosis a reason to demonise. Secondly it measures by limiting a sky, by making a cloud where an aeon could fly, blocking light to reify. Third it seals with patterned definition, neither side holds the other, nor self recognition. Alive is a logic landing humility as provision, as primary and axiomatic, as prerequisite of precision. We start with the sky open wide, with the one truth for which thought has no vision, ever aloof, zero-and-one as one impossible act of re-cognition. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q015) · Extracted authorial poem. The poem opens with an issue in our age and turns one into One before widening the scene through panes, air, planets, bodies and weather. Two makes the bond perceptible; time can divide for a shared future. The critique of severance then gives three reasons: the cutting mind is derived, its measure limits the sky, and its definitions seal each side away from the other. Humility enters as a prerequisite of precision. Read with P3, this preserves productive differentiation while exposing the cut that forgets its bond; the open sky at the end answers the blocked frame at the beginning. ### FT-P16 — P5: God is not a thing to argue over > God is not a thing to argue over, to believe in or deny; it is a word with many contexts, evolutions and definitions, that points somewhere no word can stand. Every word is born of difference, hold the different ones in hand; left and right run away from each other, but together master the span. We define God in terms that require no belief; we use numbers as symbols to express what words alone couldn't reach. Before All, God has always been the One, and yet we're beached, 2000+ years and the formula unimpeached. Number is the language of demonstrative proof, not age-doctored doctrines distilled from real visionary excretes. We offer a coherent and evolving account of God, one that includes it's own release; whereof one must be silent, there one shouldn't speak. And yet the essence of the project is to find the limit, so, to speak. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q016) · Extracted authorial poem. God moves from a proposed object of dispute into a word whose pointing exceeds the place words can occupy. Left and right master a span together; symbolic number enters the account, and the account includes its own release. The close turns an injunction to silence through three small pauses, so, to, speak. Those pauses make finding the limit an act of language. The historical duration and doctrinal polemic inside the verse remain Taylor's utterance; quoting the complete poem does not turn them into independently established history. ## #3 — Dated encounters and the speaker changed by speaking The journal poems return to a speaker who undergoes what he can articulate. March gives contradiction a social and bodily pressure; May develops the unnamed referent, difference and feeling; June lets a fitting form be returned. The changes happen within particular works and dates, not in an imposed developmental ranking. ### FT-P17 — [Bullshit and horror so plain and clear] > Bullshit and horror so plain and clear, > everyday normality still, for most, remaining dear, > yet not much more than façade on veneer, > and yet I love them all, despite my hatred and their fear [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q017) · Extracted authorial poem. Horror and everyday normality occupy the same four-line field. Façade on veneer doubles the thinness of what remains dear, but the ending does not give the speaker the comfort of abandoning its inhabitants. Love is spoken alongside my hatred and their fear. The pronouns keep that difficult implication personal. In the journal this arrives after Taylor's pressure that nothing changes while all is change, and the admission that the next move remains possible without predicting its outcome. ### FT-P18 — [The scratching is the itch] > The scratching is the itch, what a stitch up! > I could see from an early age the world rearrange the way a wish cut, > such that our basic needs became the feed of our own eventual disgust, > beyond that which we discuss, > the feed stock of what makes ugly the lives, half-dead, that we live-up, > and I could never live it down, so taking to task the takedown > I did propound in my heart the twisted means by which desires abound > and thus could let one outmatch their amount, > yet I was swallowed up nonetheless, > in need of soothing my distress, > the winds of change and the naivety razed left me, despite knowing better from best, one and the same with the washing of the brain, > My failed test, another expiremental success, > Only now split within, between the kid and sin, > two hearts in one breast as the great ones did hint, > but by dint of this duality my reality did rescind - > I am blessed to know those who can hold open the door to my own way, > mostly they live in the realm that is no-way, the regions of life to which modernity has no say, > bar those whose role in the game is to curtail for their own sake. > But time has conspired to set the pot ablaze, fired to let the colours bake into the vessel of a new age, > set against and upon the stage that is built of impotences own rage, funnily enough it's saving grace. > I could lament my not having acted sooner, my having kept the cards close to my chest but then I'd have been another assumer, another reporter or truther, another speaking from, not to, distress. > Time has conspired because time is all our breathing, > and I am a bitter pill, sweet coating, relieving, > I am a symbol unbelieving, of the hauling and the heaving, > and I must be on the line if I am to bait the nourishment for our healing. > I was told today that a choice must be made between what sooths me to sleep and what let's me entrain > those very forces whose captured uptake has left the cleft wide open without the voice of the age... > And how has it left me? Returning to the same old pattern, recapitulating the stagnation > I rail against in what happens to simply be the inertia of the everyday "I must have (x)". But it's not eradication I seek, for underneath the sense of me has handed over to the action's own speech, of which my entire soul as aperture is a mouth to be breached, > and I know that what will settle is a natural mettle, and an incoussiant valuation of what takes me from my station to my peak. > But without the choice I am idle, with it I'm besseched. > It is no trite accretion of the image of the anointed, nor bland convalescence to the inversion appointed, but a true reconciliation in me of the brothers, > for how else can I become the right light unto others? [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q018) · Extracted authorial poem. The attempt to understand manufactured desire is itself swallowed by the need for soothing. The speaker's knowledge does not spare him the capture he describes. Kid and sin become two hearts in one breast; the opened door and the firing of a vessel then make a different use of the same forces imaginable. The later distinction between speaking from distress and speaking to it changes the speaker's office. Time, breath and the bitter pill bring that change toward a choice between soothing sleep and entrainment. Even after this choice appears, stagnation returns. The last movement explicitly seeks no eradication: reconciliation of the brothers within must make the speaker capable of becoming a right light to others. The final revised witness preserves this aftermath, which an excerpt ending at the kiln would lose. ### FT-P19 — [The unchanging is beyond consequence] > The unchanging is beyond consequence, but is the opposite of inconsequential... What allows for an essence is essentially inessential... What builds for itself a journey is perpetually residential... > Sojourning through time yet unmovingly presidential... Silent but in structure reverential... Context total yet totally incidental... Foundation of mind, unfound by the mental... [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q019) · Extracted authorial poem. The referent is withheld while seven clauses disclose what depends upon it. Beyond consequence does not mean inconsequential; residence remains within journey, and movement through time does not displace what presides. The final clause locates the mind's foundation beyond the mind's finding. Taylor explicitly resisted replacing the withheld referent with atman or witness: naming either draws it into the distinctions the poem is traversing. The journey through such distinctions is necessary and self-negating. A later authorial instruction in the same conversation places the context clause before the silence clause, so that context carries #4, silence #5, and the final mind clause the 5→0 return. The complete quotation above preserves the canonical compilation's two-line witness, which still has silence before context. The revised order is stated here as Taylor's instruction, not silently substituted for the verse. His further demand is to derive the positions from the primary determinations, rather than assign an already finished poem to six slots. **Human-amplified: yes** for this withheld-referent and sequence correction. ### FT-P20 — [The notion born of difference] > the notion born of difference is incremental, > depending for presence of the inferential, > whilst speaking plain not a hint tangential, > broaching it's branches without asking for permissions consensual [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q020) · Extracted authorial poem. Taylor calls these four clauses the preceding poem's encapsulation. The notion grows through difference and depends upon inference for presence, yet speaks plainly and branches without requesting consent. This short work has its own beginning, cadence and end even in that close relation to FT-P19. Keeping both complete allows the encapsulation to gather the longer movement without replacing it. ### FT-P21 — [The infinite multiplied by the infinitesimal] > The infinite multiplied by the infinitesimal makes a a field differential nested in and made of the principle of sameness - I am the same, I know difference - I have knowledge of difference, I am seeking it's sameness [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q021) · Extracted authorial poem. The sentence first makes a differential field from the infinite and infinitesimal, then follows four first-person clauses: being the same, knowing difference, having that knowledge, and seeking sameness. The repetitions and changes of verb matter as much as the two opening quantities. Taylor's subsequent correction requires both a static and a processual reading: a thing and its thinging, definite identity and the activity through which it is specified. Multiplication carries expansive plenitude together with precise differentiation. He then calls for a second, divisional reading. The first passage must complete 0/1, its 4+2 field and 5→0 return before the inversion to 1/0 opens a full 4′+2′ and 5′→0′ passage back to 0/1. Division does not replace the original word multiplied in the verse, and the inverse half cannot be compressed into the first return. This authorial reading restores the ordered movement around the sentence; it does not declare an indeterminate product or quotient a valid calculus identity. Independent mathematical claims require the native matheme's derivation and their own mathematical conditions. **Human-amplified: yes** for the two-pass, noun/verb correction. ### FT-P22 — What is it to feel? > What is it to feel? > To take in and undergo, how else does a feeling know? > Yo churn or chime, no wonder, whether on a dime > Or once in a while, riled or reconciled by time. > I am either a sea's plaything or the captain of the "mine". > To feel is to live in what lives through you, > It is the way I quaked when the winds blew through, > Until it's how I relate to the one in the boots. > Feeling has it's way and away, until the day, anew, > Where dawn's heart in mind, or rather Venus holds > And yet unfolds intuition, Sophia, martian, though kind and bold, > Solid and chilling where we can't afford to fold, > Mellifluous sunshine for the quiet estates of old [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q022) · Extracted authorial poem. Feeling first takes in and undergoes. The sea's plaything and captain of the mine offer two positions inside that experience; the winds still pass through the one who quakes. Taylor's explicit correction identifies the boots through quaking in my boots. Relating to the one in them means becoming able to relate consciously to one's own emotions and to the feeler who undergoes them. An earlier conversational gloss made the relation primarily one to a brother; Taylor rejected that reading. The dawning movement consequently changes how feeling is lived, rather than promising that feeling will disappear. Venus holds and unfolds intuition; Sophia and the martian occur in a field capable of kindness, boldness, chilling solidity and mellifluous warmth. These changing tonal offices complete this poem.
